item.title: Tour Joseph Allen Stein's New Delhi, a place where modernism 'allows you to slow down'
item.description: In New Delhi, a little-known enclave known as Steinabad reveals the radical legacy of American modernist Joseph Allen Stein. Now, boutique travel company Architourian is turning this shaded cluster of cultural landmarks into a pilgrimage for design lovers

item.title: David Byrne’s new tour asks the most radical question of all: how do we move together?
item.description: After reshaping the modern concert with American Utopia, David Byrne returns with Who Is the Sky? – and a new choreographic collaborator in Steven Hoggett. As the UK leg begins, they discuss joy, unity and why love might be the most punk gesture left

item.title: Molteni & C’s 2026 outdoor collection gracefully welcomes the return of spring
item.description: As spring springs, the Italian brand unveils its new collection, led by Vincent Van Duysen: a cohesive system of refined, technically sophisticated furnishings which extend the ethos of the home outdoors

item.title: 'The complexity comes through when you include different perspectives': artist Lindsay Perryman on the intimate photobook, 'Tops'
item.description: 'Tops,' by Lindsay Perryman and published by Palm* Studios, considers the importance of community and care in the queer community

item.title: Kirkby takes Transport for London upholstery from carriage seat to contemporary interior
item.description: Eight archival TfL patterns –originally conceived as functional public art by artists such as Enid Marx and Marion Dorn –have been reimagined as sumptuous velvets by textile brand Kirkby

item.title: In Montauk, a century-old horse barn has been sensitively reimagined as a retreat for artists and writers
item.description: With his eponymous foundation, playwright Edward Albee wanted to ‘serve writers and visual artists from all walks of life’. Thanks to a careful restoration by TenBerke architects, Albee’s vision is entering a triumphant new chapter

item.title: The standout shows of Milan Fashion Week A/W 2026, from Prada to Bottega Veneta
item.description: Wallpaper* picks the 14 best shows of Milan Fashion Week – a season marked by debuts at Gucci, Marni and Fendi, alongside a multi-layered Prada show and vivid expressions of texture at Bottega Veneta

item.title: Holly Hunt's latest collection signals an evolution for the legacy brand
item.description: Wallpaper* speaks to Holly Hunt executive creative director Jo Annah Kornak and design director Chris Eitel about evolving a legacy brand without losing its identity

item.title: Changan launches in Europe with two mid-sized electric SUVs. We try the S05 for size
item.description: The Changan S05 is a comprehensively equipped EV at a very competitive price. Will it be enough for the Chinese giant to woo European customers?

item.title: Discover Krayon, the independent watch brand bringing simplicity back to watchmaking
item.description: Swiss watch brand Krayon does the basics well. Learn more about their mechanical watches here
